## 1. Vectors

```{r}
age <- c(20, 35, 32, 29)
summary(age)
mean(age)
gender <- c("M", "F", "F", "M")
class(gender)
```

## 2. Matrix

```{r}
x <- matrix(1:6, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
y <- matrix(1:6, nrow = 3, ncol = 2)
x %*% y
```

## 3. List and factor

```{r}
my_list <- list(1, "a", TRUE)
my_list
answer <- factor(c("yes", "yes", "no", "yes", "no"))
table(answer)
```

## 4. Missing values

```{r}
x <- c(1, 2, NA, 10, 3)
is.na(x)
mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
```

## 5. Data frame

```{r}
studentID  <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
gender     <- c("M", "F", "M", "M", "F")
math_score <- c(12, 17, 10, 9, NA)
it_score   <- c(13, 18, 11, 10, 19)
scoredata  <- data.frame(studentID, gender, math_score, it_score)
scoredata
```

## 6. Built-in data and summary

```{r}
data("women")
str(women)
summary(women)
apply(women, 2, sd)
```

## 7. Mean by group

```{r}
by(iris$Petal.Length, iris$Species, mean)
boxplot(Sepal.Length ~ Species, data = iris)
```

## 8. Two categorical variables

```{r}
ucba  <- data.frame(UCBAdmissions)
cross <- xtabs(Freq ~ Gender + Admit, data = ucba)
cross
prop.table(cross, 1)
```

## 9. Graphs and regression

```{r}
plot(weight ~ height, data = women)
abline(lm(weight ~ height, data = women))
cor(women$height, women$weight)
model <- lm(weight ~ height, data = women)
summary(model)
hist(women$weight)
```

## 10. New variable (BMI)

```{r}
women$BMI <- round((women$weight * 0.4536) / (women$height * 0.0254)^2, 1)
head(women)
```

## 11. Dates

```{r}
today <- Sys.Date()
format(today, "%A %d %B %Y")
dob <- as.Date("1997-01-01")
difftime(today, dob, units = "days")
```

## 12. Missing values, sorting and subsetting

```{r}
manager <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
gender  <- c("M", "F", "F", "M", "F")
age     <- c(32, 45, 25, 39, 99)
q1      <- c(5, 3, 3, 3, 2)
q2      <- c(4, 5, 5, NA, 2)
leadership <- data.frame(manager, gender, age, q1, q2)

leadership$age[leadership$age == 99] <- NA
na.omit(leadership)
leadership[order(leadership$age), ]
subset(leadership, gender == "M", select = c(manager, age))
```
